biography: Cássio Homem de Mello's journey began amidst the sun-drenched streets of São Paulo, a stark contrast to the roaring engines that would later define his life. His entry into racing wasn't paved with family wealth or karting pedigree; instead, it was forged in the crucible of street races, a dangerous, raw proving ground. Legend has it that a talent scout, nursing a hangover in a back-alley bar, witnessed Cássio's audacious overtaking maneuver, a move so improbable it defied physics. That scout, a grizzled veteran of Copa Montana, saw a spark – a reckless brilliance – that couldn't be ignored. His break came with a small, underfunded team. Now, at 36, Cássio stands at the peak of his abilities, a Copa Montana veteran known for his aggressive style and unpredictable maneuvers. He's aiming for the championship title, a goal that would cement his legacy as one of Brazil's most exciting racing talents.
drivingStyle: Cássio's driving style is best described as 'controlled chaos'. He attacks corners with a late-braking, high-entry speed approach that often leaves spectators gasping. While some accuse him of being overly aggressive, his ability to manage tire degradation under pressure is surprisingly adept. He thrives on the adrenaline of close racing, often pushing his car, and his competitors, to the absolute limit.

rivalries.reason: A long-standing feud ignited by a controversial collision at Interlagos, where Cássio accused Ricardo of deliberately blocking him.
A fierce on-track rivalry fueled by a clash of egos and contrasting driving philosophies. Isabela favors a calculated approach, while Cássio embraces raw aggression.
The veteran Marcos, once a mentor to Cássio, now finds himself challenged by the younger driver's audacious moves, leading to heated battles on and off the track.

quirks: Always wears a lucky 'Figa' charm given to him by his grandmother.
Listens to heavy metal music at deafening volumes right before each race to 'get in the zone'.
Refuses to start a race without first touching his helmet three times.
famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe. It's about finding the edge, dancing on it, and daring anyone to follow."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2020 Copa Montana race at Curitiba after starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying penalty, overtaking twelve cars in the final five laps.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the 2018 championship decider at Interlagos while leading, costing him the title and earning him widespread criticism for recklessness.
